mechanism: Both drugs can cause esophageal irritation and gastrointestinal adverse effects; isotretinoin may impair bone metabolism while alendronate affects bone remodeling, potentially complicating therapeutic outcomes in patients with compromised bone health.
action: Monitor for GI symptoms; ensure alendronate is taken with adequate water in upright position; counsel on timing separation; monitor bone health parameters and consider gastroenterology consultation if GI symptoms develop.
